notes: Part count: 134 non-repeated pieces (b1-b134) plus 8 legs x 10 pieces = 214, matching the parts list.

The 7 separate groups are real, not a modelling gap, so I kept them. (1) Gollum's ruin (b1-b29) is the first of the booklet's two builds, with its own title page, and the booklet never joins it to the spider. (2) Shelob is the second build and is one connected group: body, 8 legs, fangs, head and abdomen. The abdomen joins the body through the ball loop b56 on ball b55 and b56's pin in socket brick b86. (3) The other 5 groups are the loose accessories b130 (sword), b131 (gladius), b132 (ring), b133 (gem) and b134 (fish). They belong to the Frodo, Sam and Gollum minifigures. Those minifigures are not in the parts list, and the booklet shows no step attaching these five to any listed piece. Edges to them would be invented, so there are none.

The steps are small pictures, so many stud-to-stud attachments are best guesses at which piece sits on which, and ports are null for them. This is especially true for the ruin cheese slopes (b19, b20, b23, b24, b26, b27) and the step 4 to 8 attachments in Shelob's body.

Each leg is modelled as: a 1x4 base plate with two 1-finger hinge plates; a 2-finger hinge plate hinged to each hinge plate; a cheese slope on the first; a hinge cylinder on the second; and a claw in the cylinder. The leg's third 2-finger hinge plate (c3) and tile are placed on the hinge plates by assumption.
Each leg's first hinge plate (c1) is attached to one of the eight body swivel hinge plates (b32-b35, b39, b40, b42, b43). The template endpoint b32:stud.1.1 is overridden per copy.
Ruin step 5: I read the black 2x2 plate with pin holes (b16) as the piece that takes the Technic pin b7 from step 3.
In the abdomen, the string axle b105 passes through the cockpit piece b81 and carries the string reels b107 and b108, plus gears b110 and b112. The string b106 ties the reel to the hook b109.
